title: This Is An MTB Battle! Kore ga MTB BATTLE da!
overview: Chaos at home, Sho Yamato races to the X-Zone. Black smoke transports him and rival Gabu to a strange new world. They're arrested for illegal biking.

title: Big Escape! Sand Dune Battle Daidassou! Sakyuu no tatakai
overview: Sho and his friends are lost in a treacherous world. Facing danger and competition, they must use their mountain biking skills to escape. Will they find their way home?

title: Crash! The First Defeat? Shougeki! Hajimete no haiboku?
overview: Sho and his friends battle Gabu's team in the treacherous X-Zone. Can they overcome this setback and emerge stronger?

title: Take Back! My MTB! Torimodose! Ore no MTB!
overview: Sho's prized MTB, Flame Kaiser, is stolen. He must race against skilled rivals, using his bike skills and strategy, to reclaim it and win.

title: Fiery Volcano Battle!! Honoo no kazan no BATTLE!!
overview: Sho and his friends face a volcanic race, battling tough terrain and rivals. Can their MTB skills and teamwork conquer the dangerous obstacles and win?

title: A High-Tech Group's Challenge HIGH-TECH shuudan no chousen
overview: Sho and his friends face the Hyper Brain team in a thrilling MTB race. Can Sho use his skills and tactics to outpace their rivals and claim victory?

title: Ouch! MTB's Graveyard Auu! MTB no hakaba
overview: Sho and his friends battle rivals in the MTB Cemetery, a graveyard of abandoned bikes with treacherous terrain. Can they overcome the obstacles and conquer the challenge?

title: Enter Neptune! NEPTUNE toujou!
overview: The legendary Neptune bike holds secrets. A team faces rivals for its power. Can Sho master it and win?

title: The Identity Of The Masked Boy Kamen shounen no shoutai
overview: Sho Yamato and his team unveil the Mask Rider's secret identity, uncovering the motive behind their actions. Can they adapt their strategy to defeat this growing threat?

title: The Strongest Rival Appears!
overview: Sho's toughest MTB race yet pits them against a rival with unmatched skill and a powerful bike. Can Sho and their team rise to the challenge?

title: Onboard Battle! Team ST's Trap
overview: Sho races aboard a massive ship, navigating narrow paths, and shifting terrain. Can Sho outmanoeuvre his opponents and claim victory in this challenging race?

title: The Admired Celeb Resort City
overview: Sho Yamato's dream of becoming the best rider is on the line. Facing tough rivals, his fierce determination will be tested. Can he win the thrilling race?

title: School Battle! Explosion, Idaten Cross!
overview: Sho Yamato and his friends navigate a treacherous school, dodging obstacles and battling skilled riders. Can Sho adapt to this unique race and claim victory?

title: The Man Who Beat Flame Kaiser?
overview: In a mining town, children meet siblings Saya and her brother. Saya claims her brother can defeat Flame Kaizer, but his strange behavior hints at a hidden secret.

title: The Prince of MTB
overview: Makoto arrives at the Aqua Palace, destined to be the prince's bride. But he holds a secret - he's Team ST. Her mission: uncover his truth. Will she succeed?

title: Struggle In The Rain, Awakened Neptune
overview: A month-long journey to X City leaves the kids disheartened. A broken trailer and Makoto's quitting spark a heated battle. Who will prevail?

title: Finally Understand! Team ST's Secret
overview: Yuki's shortcut to X-City plunges them into a demon-haunted cavern. As fear grips Sho and his friends, a mysterious figure emerges. Can they survive the darkness?

title: A New Assassin! The Test's Battle Between Siblings
overview: Shido doubts Makoto's Neptune awakening. To travel to X City, Sho and Makoto must pass a tough test. Will they succeed?

title: Showdown! Flame Kaiser VS. Thunder Emperor
overview: Despite passing the test, Shido still calls Sho immature, fuelling Sho's frustration. They agree to settle the score with an Idaten Battle. Who will win the battle?

title: Formidable Opponent! Ninja Rider Kokage
overview: Sho's battle with Shido is interrupted by Koei's ninja skills, sending Shido falling. Sho trains fiercely, blindfolded, to prepare for the final showdown against Koei. Can he win?

title: X City's Gate Guardians
overview: Reaching X-City's gate, the kids are denied entry. Facing the Guardian Brothers, they must navigate a treacherous battle course. Can they overcome the obstacles and gain access?

title: Arrival! X City
overview: X City falls under the tyrannical grip of Team Shark Tooth. Sho, fueled by righteous anger, challenges their leader, Tiger Jiro, to an Idaten Battle. Will justice prevail?

title: The Idaten Battle Tournament Begins!
overview: Sho arrives in X-City just as the I Daten tournament kicks off. The prize: 7 Gold Emblems. Can she win and return home a champion?

title: Crash! Flame Kaiser VS. Neptune
overview: Sho is ready for the tournament, but his first opponent is Makoto. Will he face his friend in a duel? Who will take the title?

title: Hammerhead! The 6th Idaten Bike
overview: The B Block heats up with Samejima Taiga, Gen, Arthur, and more battling for supremacy. Who will emerge victorious in this fierce clash?

title: Certain Kill! Shido Special
overview: Sho and his friends fight for his return home in an epic tournament. But what is Keoichi's secret weapon?

title: Battle! Hammerhead VS. Aero Scissors!
overview: Sho gets a dream about his father who encourages him to focus on the finals. Furthermore, Gabu fires Taiga after his defeat. Will this bring repurcussions to the tournament?

title: The Final Showdown's Conspiracy
overview: Gabu manipulates the competition to ensure Koei's victory, but Koei, disillusioned by the deceit, confronts him. Will Koei betray his principles for success?

title: Final Battle! Who Will Be The Victor?
overview: Gabu executes his devious plan and gets Kiku kidnapped. He tries to use her to gain advantage over Koei. Will Sho and his friends be able to rescue Kiku and protect her?

title: Charge! X Tower
overview: Sho and friends bask in victory, but Gabu has a trick up his sleeve. What mischievous scheme is he plotting?

title: Decisive Battle! Flame Kaiser VS. Bloody Fang
overview: Sho wins the Idaten Battle, but Gabu steals the emblems. As Sho battles Gabu, the Four Kings take away the emblems. Will show be able to retrieve back what is rightfully his?

title: Farewell X Zone
overview: While wandering around in the tower, Sho catches a glimpse of Imperial X. Meanwhile Gabu is furious at his defeat. Will he take another hasty step out of anger?

title: A New, Formidable Enemy
overview: Sho's dream of Miss Yuki and his father's secret is shattered by a tide. He desperately tries to convince Ayumu and his mom about the X-Zone's existence.

title: To X Zone Again!
overview: Sho and his friends crave a return to X Zone, but their path remains unclear. A bike repair sparks conflict, putting their mission in jeopardy.

title: Shock! Sho's Father Is Alive
overview: After a tremendous battle with some mysterious people, Sho and his friends find clues about his dad's disappearance. Will they find out the truth?

title: Roar! Imperial Dragon!!
overview: Sho and his friends chase Team X to Imperial Island to retrieve the stolen Imperial X. Ayumu's kidnapping complicates their mission. Can Sho rescue his friend and reclaim the X?

title: The Feared Dark Emblem
overview: Sho, victorious in Massaji, continues his quest. But a new challenge awaits: Kyoichi's Team X. Count Freddy, under orders, must test Sho's strength - but can he win?

title: Gabu's Allure, Flame Kaiser's In A Pinch!
overview: On their journey to Imperial Island, Sho and Hosuke encounter Sayji and Mantaro. A cryptic letter from Gabu throws their plans into question.

title: Climax! Imperial Dragon VS. Aero Scissors Hakunetsu!
overview: Sho and friends blindly search Imperial Island for Team X's hidden HQ. Elsewhere, Koei secretly visits his ill sister, warning her to conceal their sibling bond from Team X.

title: The Nameless Forest's Vermin
overview: Sho and his friends face perils in X-Zone's Nameless Forest, determined to reach Imperial Island. But danger lurks, testing their resolve. Will they make it?

title: Arthur's Challenge!
overview: Makoto and Sho unite their Idaten Bikes for an epic "Idaten Cross," powering through a waterfall to advance in their race. Can their combined strength propel them to victory?

title: Idaten Bike's Big Gathering!
overview: Sho, Makoto, and Arthur jump across sea pillars to reach Imperial Island, overcoming the final challenge in their journey. Will they successfully complete their adventure?

title: Sho VS. Shido! Battle Of Life Or Death!
overview: Shaw and Keoichi face off in a high-stakes duel that tests their deepest convictions. As their souls clash, who will emerge victorious in this ultimate battle for supremacy?

title: Shocking Reunion! Imperial X Appears
overview: Imperial X reveals its terrifying true form, plunging the world into chaos and fear. What dark secrets lie behind this revelation?

title: The Second Island Appears! The Beginning Of The World's Collapse
overview: A new island rises from the depths, shaking the world's foundations and spreading panic. As the landscape shifts, can the heroes prevent the impending disaster?

title: Charge! Team X VS. Imperial Dragon Daishuugeki!
overview: Takeshi's dark power threatens to engulf X-Zone. Can anyone stop the escalating chaos before it consumes everything?

title: The Legendary Training Grounds, Sho's Special Training!
overview: Sho faces ultimate tests in legendary training grounds, pushing him to his limits. Will he emerge stronger or fall?

title: The Miracle Power!
overview: Sho discovers a miracle power, unleashing a new secret move with explosive force. As his opponents are caught off guard, can Sho master this power in time to secure victory?

title: Flame Kaiser Vs Imperial X!
overview: Gabu watches Kyoichi, Sho, and Makoto perform, a knowing smile on his face. He wonders if Sho can overcome the challenge of facing Neptune.

title: he Battle for Imperial Island!
overview: Sho and his friends face unexpected obstacles as they journey to mysterious Imperial Island. Will they overcome the challenges and reach their destination?

title: The Battle of Destiny,The Final Battle!
overview: Imperial Island hangs in the balance as Sho and his friends face their ultimate test. Destiny awaits, but will they rise to the challenge?

title: Awakening the World
overview: The fate of X-Zone rests on Sho and his friends' shoulders as they unlock a new power to restore balance. Time is running out.
